hld.executive_summary: Build me a E-COmmerce application for Vegetables is designed as an enterprise-grade Modular Monolith architecture for Build Me A E-Commerce Application For Vegetables. The system isolates core domain workflows into resilient, independently deployable services backed by PostgreSQL 16 and Redis 7.2 Cluster.
business_goals: Achieve 99.9% system availability for Build Me A E-Commerce Application For Vegetables operations.
Ensure sub-250ms p95 response time under concurrent user load.
Enforce strict transaction consistency and data auditability.
